{{Quote|Let's make one thing clear: You are here to free me.|Veem Set|<ref name="Witness" />}}
'''Veem Set''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was captured by [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] separatists and locked inside the separatist stronghold. Republic official [[Milo Phipps]] believed Set had important information on the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] that could potentially end the [[Separatist War]] and hired a sympathetic citizen to free him. However, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bendick]] had a different opinion and suggested that the blood-thirsty pirate could meet an unfortunate incident instead.<ref name="Witness" />
